description.text: The Dragon Discovery promotion, mostly of Dragon-type Pokémon. Each Happy Meal held a four-card pack with one holo card, a poster and a sheet of stickers for it. It began in France on 4 December 2024 and reached the United States on 21 January 2025 and Austria two days later. In the United States, ordering it through the McDonald's app also unlocked rewards in Pokémon TCG Pocket. Seven of the 15 cards are holo: Pikachu, Miraidon, Koraidon, Hydreigon, Roaring Moon, Dragonite and Drampa.
